cohort: 724 primiparous pregnancies (362 receiving continuous support and 362 receiving routine hospital maternal care)
finding: Continuous support from family members and hospital professional staff during labour was associated with shorter labour duration and lower rates of emergency caesarean section compared to routine hospital maternal care.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section rate was significantly lower in women with supportive care compared to women with routine hospital maternal care (3.3% vs 24%).
